D-bear-walk-0012.name: 880 m S of Platt Creek
D-bear-walk-0012.pressureWhy: 1.3 km on foot from the nearest parking inside a motor vehicle closure (estimate).

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2021 (fire K71086), 230 m SE: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 11 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 160 m NE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.
Above 1,700 m: in Region 3 no motor vehicles except snowmobiles, except on existing roads and trails (synopsis page 33, 99%). Elevation from terrain tiles (estimate).

plan: Drive: from Merritt, about 49 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.18559, -121.29989, pull off on Br. 2.2.1 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.3 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 125 m, about 39 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-13, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-17, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-17.
D-bear-walk-0012.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-13: about 1,007 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.42 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
